title.value: De-risking Carbon Capture and Sequestration with Explainable CO2 Leakage Detection in Time-lapse Seismic Monitoring Images
title.justification: The title clearly states the focus on Carbon Capture and Sequestration (CCS) and the detection of CO2 leakage using seismic monitoring images.
title.quote: De-risking Carbon Capture and Sequestration with Explainable CO2 Leakage Detection in Time-lapse Seismic Monitoring Images

extractions.description: The paper discusses the use of deep learning models for detecting CO2 leakage in carbon capture and storage (CCS) projects using time-lapse seismic imaging. It introduces binary classification models to identify CO2 plumes and uses Class Activation Mapping for localization of leakage regions.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper's central focus is on improving Carbon Capture and Sequestration (CCS) technology, which is a crucial method for reducing greenhouse gas emissions to combat climate change.

primary_category.justification: The paper directly addresses Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) technology, which is a key strategy for reducing atmospheric CO2 levels and mitigating climate change.
primary_category.quote: ... there is a need for a 50 percent reduction of greenhouse gas emissions by 2050 ... CCS is considered a relatively low-cost, long-term and imminent solution.

secondary_categories.quote: ... time-lapse seismic monitoring has been introduced as a reliable technology to monitor the CO2 dynamics in the Earth’s subsurface during carbon sequestration.
